description: # E-Project Smart Waterfall - Advanced Waterfall Chart for Power BI Elevate your data visualization with E-Project Smart Waterfall, a powerful custom visual for Power BI designed to enhance your analytical capabilities through a highly customizable and responsive Waterfall Chart. Developed by E-Project Srl, this tool provides deep insights through a combination of flexible data modeling and tailored visual styling. ## Why Choose E-Project Smart Waterfall? E-Project Smart Waterfall offers a versatile approach to presenting cumulative data, with advanced customization options to suit a wide range of reporting needs. Ideal for financial analysis, project tracking, and performance measurement, it allows users to create polished and informative visuals with ease. ## Key Features * Flexible Data Model: Define waterfall columns using either a series of measures or a combination of a grouping category and a measure value, providing unmatched adaptability. * Dynamic Measure Overrides: Fine-tune your visuals with optional measures to control bar color, labels, and pillar status, ensuring maximum clarity and relevance. * Comprehensive Style Customization: * Configure gridlines, ticks, and axis attributes including colors, thickness, and visibility. * Tailor bar and axis labels with customizable fonts, colors, numerical formatting, and more. * Fully Responsive Design: Achieve a seamless…
